title: P4b: assignment in expression position
intent: Decide the #118 expression surface: is assignment (compound += and plain =) an expression in OSTW, or statement-only? Rejected in p4-types-expressions with 'Expected a variable' on (selector += 1); this probe isolates both compound and plain assignment in condition position.

provenance.origin: Wright QA semantic probe for issue #118

provenanceNote: QA-authored source, split out of p4-types-expressions after the reference rejected (selector += 1) in condition position with parse errors; adds a plain-assignment variant (selector = 2) to distinguish compound vs plain assignment in expression position.
